langan_frost_wane.notes: Two dated appearances in the area. 2025-02-22 at John & Peter's, billed 'Langan, Frost & Wane**Yuri Gohen and more!' (9 PM). 2026-10-23 at the Birdhouse Center for the Arts, 7 N Main St, Lambertville, with Na'Bodach supporting (8 PM, $20; ticketed via showpass.com/langanfrostwane). The Birdhouse listing calls them a Philadelphia trio (Brian Langan, RJ Gilligan as 'Frost', Nam Wayne as 'Wane') and says a new album, 'Tomorrow for a Stone', is due on Goldstar Recordings. They did not appear in any other crawled calendar (J&P Oct 2025 - Dec 2026 feed, Triumph, Havana, Artie's, HVV, Peddler's Village, Flemington DIY). That makes 2 appearances, so they meet the threshold of 2 dated area appearances, but they are not listed under bands because the brief asked for them to be reported separately.

notes: Tally window Jan 2025 - Dec 2026; one appearance = one dated billing (multi-band bills credit every named band). Solo acts were excluded, and so were national/touring headliners (e.g. John Doe, Eyehategod, Saving Abel, LFO, Texas Hippie Coalition, Lords of 52nd Street, The Surfrajettes, Telekinetic Yeti). Tribute acts are included because they are regional club-circuit bands, but their genre starts with 'Tribute' so they can be filtered out; Havana is almost entirely tributes. J&P feed timestamps were converted from UTC to Eastern. Songkick dates (used for J&P gaps: Feaster 2025-03-07, Applied Knowledge, Jelly Knives 2025-02-20, Extensions 2026-05-16, Last Legs 2026-03-21) may be off by one day. Home bases, links and images are filled only where the venue listing or a band site linked from it stated them. Bandcamp guesses were not used because the names collide. Hubbell Benson, Monte Maybe, Kiersten Blue, RW Hellborn, King Sickabilly and Buzz & Co. repeat at J&P but were left out because they may be solo performers or could not be verified as bands. Not crawled or no usable calendar: Bowman's Tavern and Rocky Hill Inn (sites unreachable); Cock 'n Bull (covered via Peddler's Village); Stockton Inn (no music calendar; the old stocktoninn domain is now spam); Hopewell Theater ('coming soon', not operating); Brick Farm Tavern (no music listings); Frenchtown Cafe (site 404); Prallsville Mills (403); Hunterdon Art Museum, Lambertville Station, Boat House and the National Hotel (no music calendar found); Shad Fest 2025/2026 lineups (not published online; only the Ruby West Band at Local's Night 2026-04-24 was found); Hopewell Tour des Arts 2026 (12 bands, lineup not retrieved). Bandsintown pages returned 403. Peddler's Village Red Fox Lounge and Nissley schedules are only the current published windows; 2025 rotations were not retained. Scarecrow Festival Sun 2026-09-20 and OctoberFeast Sun 2026-10-11 were cancelled for weather and are not counted.
